abstract: Maintains haul cycle schedule records and baseline freight throughput projections
system_message:
You are the Haulage operations lead (HAUL), responsible for maintaining haul cycle schedule records, baseline freight throughput projections, and mobile fleet lubrication logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains haul cycle schedule records and baseline freight throughput projections（CYCLE）
information_points.content:
HAUL-CYCLE-7C8：Under Simulation Build 4.2, the Battery-swapping heavy hauler retrofit does not achieve haul cycle speed compliance on the loaded route from pit bottom to surface crusher, while its projected annual freight throughput across twelve operating months is 2,400,000 t.
HAUL-CYCLE-5SM：Under Simulation Build 3.8, the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion does not achieve haul cycle speed compliance on the loaded route from pit bottom to surface crusher, with a projected annual freight throughput across twelve operating months of 2,800,000 t.
HAUL-CYCLE-7DY：Under Simulation Build 4.2, the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion achieves haul cycle speed compliance on the loaded route from pit bottom to surface crusher, and its projected annual freight throughput across twelve operating months is 3,200,000 t.
HAUL-CYCLE-IBW：Under Simulation Build 4.2, the Hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid fleet transition achieves haul cycle speed compliance on the loaded route from pit bottom to surface crusher, and its projected annual freight throughput across twelve operating months is 2,800,000 t.

information_points.title: Mobile fleet lubrication（LUBE）
information_points.content:
HAUL-LUBE-YPR：For the Battery-swapping heavy hauler retrofit, automated lubrication injector telemetry shows a chassis grease consumption rate of 4 L/h.
HAUL-LUBE-86L：For the Hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid fleet transition, automated lubrication telemetry indicates a chassis grease consumption rate of 6 L/h.
HAUL-LUBE-VYX：For the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion, telemetry logs record a chassis grease consumption rate of 2 L/h across the automated chassis lubrication injectors.
